hazards.evidence: Large bold black-and-white chevron high-contrast rug on the bedroom floor, which a person with dementia may misperceive as holes, steps, or a barrier, increasing fall/hesitation risk.
Electric space heater is switched on (glowing orange) at the foot/side of the bed, directly beside draped bedding/comforter that hangs down to it, creating a fire and burn risk.
